title: PixelKin - The Bottom of the Cup
_note: The hallucination's floor: the Wakeful Fair tune slowed to 84 and dreamt — a flute carrying the melody over warm sustained pads, a bell music-box arpeggio, no drums but a soft tom heartbeat on 1 and 3 that never quite stops. Woozy, sweet, a little sleepy (the Snoozlet is coming).
